subject: general
question: The centre of curvature of a concave mirror lies ______ the mirror, whereas it lies ______ the mirror for a convex. mirror.
solution:
The Correct answer is __**in front of, behind**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **centre of curvature** of a spherical mirror is the center of the sphere from which the mirror is made.
 
• For a **concave mirror**, the reflecting surface curves inward, and the **centre of curvature lies in front of the mirror**. This is because the center of the sphere is located on the same side as the reflecting surface.
 
• For a **convex mirror**, the reflecting surface curves outward, and the **centre of curvature lies behind the mirror**. The center of the sphere is located on the opposite side of the reflecting surface.
 
• The **pole**, **radius of curvature**, and **principal axis** are other important terms related to spherical mirrors. These terms help define the geometry and behavior of these mirrors.
 
• Understanding the position of the **centre of curvature** is essential for ray diagrams and calculating focal lengths in optics.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Behind, in front of**__

 __
 
• This option incorrectly states the positions of the **centre of curvature** for concave and convex mirrors.
 
• In a concave mirror, the **centre of curvature is always in front**, not behind.
 
 
 
• **In front of, in front**__
 __
 
• This option incorrectly suggests that the **centre of curvature** for both concave and convex mirrors lies in front.
 
• However, in a convex mirror, the **centre of curvature is behind** because the reflecting surface curves outward.
 
 
 
• **Behind, behind**__
 
 
• This option incorrectly states that the **centre of curvature** for both types of mirrors is behind.
 
• In reality, the concave mirror's **centre of curvature is in front**, while the convex mirror's is behind.
